title: 1753CTF 2024
description:
We're absolutely thrilled to present 1753CTF 2024, a pioneering leap into our very first independent and fully online edition of the event. 

- Focus on easier challenges with varying difficulty levels

- Fun and original challenges encouraging to learn new stuff

- Event conducted entirely on Discord through our unique bot

- Prize pool worth over $6000

- Join Discord now and use /create_team command to be ready for the party: https://discord.com/invite/5274QUjd97

Get ready for a cybersecurity adventure – we hope you'll participate!
